TKT-1.what: finish refuses a ticket whose documents are missing (docs)
the ticket folder holds its files before the ticket is called done

TKT-2.what: TICKET.md against the template and docs/specs/
TICKET.md, PLAN.md and PROGRESS.md refer to the specification

TKT-3.what: the task graph and its status line
the gate refuses a plan that is not approved

TKT-4.what: tests first, file ownership per wave, parallelism

TKT-5.what: hand-offs, integration and the single commit
agents never commit, merge or push by hand
integrate never applies a file another open ticket owns, and lists it under refused (L-34)

TKT-6.what: the checks run in a clean tree holding only the ticket's own work; a missing project module is a code failure; a failure names the file the tool reports
verify, review, documents, code review, then finish
a missing module of the project, even absent from the clean tree, is never flagged environment (L-34)
a failure goes to the changed file whose path the tool prints, even relative to a service root (L-34)
the clean tree gets the swarm_core wheel when code imports it, and fresh modification times (L-39)
pytest runs with -n 2 as CI does, and mypy is never skipped silently (L-43)
the runner gets one command and the exit code it prints decides; environment failures do not hold back the others (L-35, L-40)

TKT-7.what: every agent has the model and effort of TKT-7

TKT-8.what: assumptions are collected and passed to the reviewer
each assumption is accepted or rejected

TKT-9.what: the group report of tickets.py watch

TKT-10.what: timings and tokens written into PROGRESS.md
the scribe writes the timings at the end of every run

TKT-12.what: one full review, then confirm-only rounds; follow-ups never block
the review returns a note and its rounds
a finding owned by several tasks becomes one fix task; findings on TICKET.md and PLAN.md go to the ticket-writer and the scribe (L-34, L-41)

TKT-14.what: docs checks EXPLAIN.md and IMPLEMENTATION.md; finish refuses otherwise
finish rewrites a changes table another ticket's commit made stale, and still refuses a broken link (L-42)

TKT-15.what: no --no-verify, no push to develop or master
every pull request's branch, base and title
finish updates an open pull request through the REST API, never gh pr edit, and removes the state once pushed (L-30, L-36)

TKT-16.what: the start rule and the area locks
one checkout, the ticket's own files, one commit each
the start rule is run by the runner agent and decided by its exit code, never judged by the verifier
an open ticket continuing its run passes the area lock, and next never starts two overlapping tickets (L-38)
an area of the old layout and its new-layout path are the same area for the lock and the board

TKT-17.what: the board on GitHub and its columns

TKT-18.what: the run stops for the code review until PLAN.md says Push approved

TKT-19.what: blocking files go to their owner before the retry
a task blocked only by files later waves write counts as done (L-37); a bare folder gets no fix task (L-34)

TKT-20.what: the person confirms a group approval

TKT-21.what: a front-end ticket lists its screens
its plan captures them after the front-end work
the list of screens is complete

TKT-22.what: every rule has an enforcer that exists, beyond reading alone

TKT-23.what: done_tickets, the one definition of done; check and done refuse a done or finished ticket
refuses to plan a ticket already done
done tickets are never planned, approved or run again
a resumed bootstrap counts what exists as done

TKT-24.what: the dry run never calls GitHub; develop is found in a CI checkout
CI runs the harness tests in a shallow checkout without develop

TKT-25.what: gives every branch its verdict; deletes only merged, integrated or superseded ones, after a backup bundle
branches prints the verdicts; prune [--dry-run] acts on them
refuses a rebase, a reset or a forced push or deletion of develop or master
the pre-push hook refuses deleting develop or master on the remote
verdicts, backup before deletion, dry run, open tickets' workers kept, GitHub branches
develop and master are never rebased, reset, forced or deleted
deletes the head branch of a pull request merged into develop, unless it moved; never develop or master
a merged branch is deleted, a branch that moved is kept

TKT-26.what: runs every suite, writes the changelog, notes and test reports on release/<version>, opens the pull request to master
merges the release into master, tags it, publishes the GitHub release, merges it back into develop
writes CHANGELOG.md, RELEASE_NOTES.md and TEST_REPORT.md; refuses a release without test reports
every suite keeps its test report as a test-report-* artifact
asks the person before a release starts
release into master, tag, way back to develop, token required
every suite runs and keeps its report; the release waits for all of them
version, changelog, release notes, test report, no release without reports
